verdict.rationale: A single marketing mention positions Mistral's Document AI as available for 'secure on-premises deployment' for compliance-first enterprise customers, implying some self-hosting option exists, but there is no technical documentation, deployment guide, container image, license terms, or hardware/setup instructions provided anywhere in the evidence pack. All other evidence describes a hosted API product gated behind API keys. Missing for 10: actual self-host deployment docs, download/container artifacts, licensing details, and any independent confirmation that self-hosting works in practice.
